source_identity.STK_status: not offered in exact v3.2 Earth API STAC item

aw3d30_provenance.quality_rule: Bilinear from original native centers, every nonzero support cell must have MSK=0 and cannot be nodata. MSK is categorical, never interpolated. No use of Copernicus heights. Parent water mask yields null where present, not ground/no data. Absolute source elevations not corrected to a common datum. Compare slope shape/within-source differences only. Lake-line values are historical DSM product heights, not water depth, bathymetry or measured stage.
